locator: Alex O'Connor, "Could God Be Evil?" (Alex O'Connor, 2020-12-04), 00:18–00:47: if an all-powerful god exists who is capable of eliminating all the evil in the world
interpretation: Read as what all-powerfulness includes: an all-powerful being can eliminate any evil. Only ability is asserted, not willingness. The Catholic theory grants it (ST I q.25), so it serves as shared background for the internal form; the witness for POE-CATHOLIC-CONSISTENT-WITH-EVIL satisfies it, so the consistency does not rest on limiting God's power.
